name: Divine Expression (Mythic)
body:
Divine power and artistic expression complement each other.

Prerequisite(s): Divine Expression, 3rd mythic tier.

Benefits: Your bard level stacks with your cleric or oracle level for the purpose of gaining new types of bardic performance.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
